_readme: S449 SkyBuckwheat, 2026-10-22, after S447's five reads on claude/s447-berkeley-city-read. Berkeley City's capture (run 38948136325) found 67 of 97 programs; all 27 not found are Multimedia Arts, and the near misses name few of the state's listed codes (Animation Level I 40037, its own credit page, 1 of 13; Digital Photography 38243 read the noncredit twin 40046, 0 of 15). The state lists MM/AN 001A, MMDI005, MM/DI 22, MMART 197; the noncredit Requirements tabs print MM/DI 504A, MMART 505A. A rendered view shows the Summary tab alone (read 39793778941), so this read uses the reader's cq_view (S449): the capture's own JSON calls for each entry under section 39966, printing its navigation record (title, child pages, title-key twins cq_distinct would fold), its page, the child pages cq_children reads and the text cq_page joins, with the codes the coarse net reads. Three credit certificates and the noncredit twin of one, for the comparison. About sixteen JSON calls, no render, no model call.

questions.capture_reading: What the capture reads for a credit Multimedia Arts page: whether its Requirements child is read, and which course codes it prints beside the state's.
